title: Agents, actions and AI contract v1 (workstream A batch 2: A8-A13; synthetic only; remote MCP, model providers and prescribing partners blocked on A-S1/A-S2 and the prescribing qualification)

Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound, HMAC-protected. Never parse it.

AgentRef.description: Opaque agent principal reference (tenant from context).

CredentialRef.description: The agent credential reference: the `sid` an agent token must carry. Rotation replaces it; a token naming an earlier one is unauthenticated.

AgentCreate.description: A8: a new agent principal. The sponsor is the calling human; the scope set may not include a human-only scope or a scope the sponsor lacks; the expiry is required and bounded (A-D9 open).

AgentSponsorDecision.description: H3 3c: the offered human accepts or declines a pending sponsor offer.

offerRef.description: H3 3c: the sponsor offer this command created or decided.

AgentCommandResult.description: A8 lifecycle result. The credential reference appears only on create and rotate.

grants.description: describeAgentGrants: the scopes the agent can exercise right now (reads only while suspended; none when not live).

AgentRead.description: A8: one agent principal with its live grants. Never carries the credential reference.

AgentList.description: A8: agent principals of the tenant (OR-01 envelope), oldest first.

AgentAuditList.description: A8: the separate agent-audit stream of one agent: actor is the agent, sponsor is the sponsor of record at the time.

Deployment.description: The MCP deployment (its resource identifier, the token audience) the consent applies to.

Budget.description: A9 call budget. The hard ceilings (pending approval) are the schema maxima; a budget above them is refused.

ConsentRecord.description: A9: a named human consents that one agent may call the listed operations (MCP tools) on one deployment, within a budget, until the expiry. Operations outside the agent scope set are refused.

ConsentList.description: A9: consent records (OR-01 envelope), newest first.

BudgetRead.description: A9: the live budget usage of one agent on one deployment in the current period.

MemoryKey.description: A23: agent memory key (no free text).

SessionToolCall.description: A23: a reference to one agent_tool_calls row.

SessionAuditRef.description: A23: a reference to one agent_audit_events row.

SessionDetail.description: A23: one session with references to its tool calls and agent-audit events.

SessionList.description: A23: agent sessions, oldest first (OR-01 envelope).

MemoryWrite.description: A23: the calling agent stores one note under a key (replacing an earlier value).

MemoryPolicySet.description: A23: per-tenant policy admitting PHI-classified agent memory (default deny).

TaskPolicyRecord.description: A23: a human-owned standing policy under which an agent may schedule reads or proposal preparation.

TaskPolicyList.description: A23: standing task policies, oldest first (OR-01 envelope).

TaskSchedule.description: A23: the calling agent schedules one operation its live standing policy names.

TaskList.description: A23: scheduled agent tasks, oldest first (OR-01 envelope).

TaskRunList.description: A23: runs of one scheduled task, oldest first (OR-01 envelope).

MemoryList.description: A23: memory keys and metadata of one agent (no values), oldest first (OR-01 envelope), with the tenant PHI policy.

ActionPrepare.description: A10: prepare a proposal for an elevated (catalog approval: proposal) operation. Binds operation, payload digest, resource versions, policy version and an expiry.

payload.description: The owning operation's request body, validated by its owner at commit. A bounded keyed map (A-S6): field names are the owning body's camelCase names.

ActionProposalRead.description: A10: one proposal of the tenant.

ActionProposalList.description: A10: proposals of the tenant (OR-01 envelope), newest first.

AiDraftCreate.description: A11: ask the (synthetic) model for a draft from records the caller may already read. Output is always a draft.

AiDraftRead.description: A11: one AI draft with its provenance and freshness.

AiDraftList.description: A11: AI drafts of the tenant (OR-01 envelope), newest first.

AiUseCaseConfigure.description: A11: switch one AI use case (or, without useCase, every AI use case of the tenant) on or off. Disabling never affects deterministic workflows.

AiUseCaseList.description: A11/AS-07: the AI use-case registry with the tenant switch and the A12 gate.

AiEvaluationCommandResult.description: A12 evaluation run (synthetic cases, fake model; never clinical validation).

AiEvaluationList.description: A12: evaluation runs (OR-01 envelope), newest first.

PrescriptionCommandResult.description: A13: the shape a qualified partner would return. No partner is qualified, so every prescribing operation refuses (503 service_unavailable, reason prescribing_not_available).

ListScope.description: OR-01 scope: tenant-wide, the caller's assigned locations, or an explicit location set (locationRefs present for the last two).

ListEnvelope.description: OR-01 list envelope, shared by every list and worklist response.

asOf.description: Server instant the list was read.

appliedFilters.description: Normalized filters, including the defaults the server applied.

VocabularyVersions.description: OR-02: the version of each state vocabulary whose codes this response carries (GET /v1/vocabularies/{name}).
